grammarFocus: be 动词否定句与一般疑问句；what / who；简短肯定和否定回答。
title: At the School Gate
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。所有题目都是单选题或填空题。填空题的答案必须来自原文，且不超过规定的词数。本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方考试。
passage:
A. This is a small school. It is in a quiet town. The school gate is green. It is not big. It is small. Many students are at the gate. They are happy. It is Monday morning.

B. A woman is at the gate. She is a teacher. Her name is Ms. Li. She is not a student. She is a teacher. A boy is at the gate. His name is Tom. He is a student. He is not a teacher. He is nine years old. He is in Class 2.

C. Ms. Li says, "Good morning, Tom." Tom says, "Good morning, Ms. Li." Ms. Li asks, "Are you in Class 2?" Tom says, "Yes, I am." Ms. Li asks, "Is your teacher Ms. Wang?" Tom says, "No, she is not. My teacher is Mr. Zhang." Ms. Li says, "OK. Have a good day!" Tom says, "Thank you!"
transcript: Not applicable for this reading task.

questions.prompt: What color is the school gate?
questions.explanation: 原文说“The school gate is green.”，所以校门是绿色的。
原文说“It is not big. It is small.”，所以学校不大。
questions.evidence: It is not big. It is small.

questions.explanation: 原文说“She is a teacher.”，所以李女士是老师。
原文说“He is not a teacher.”，所以汤姆不是老师。

questions.prompt: Tom is in Class ____. (用数字填空)
questions.explanation: 原文说“He is in Class 2.”，所以汤姆在2班。
原文中汤姆说“No, she is not. My teacher is Mr. Zhang.”，所以他的老师不是王女士。
questions.evidence: No, she is not. My teacher is Mr. Zhang.

questions.prompt: Tom's teacher is Mr. ____. (用姓氏填空)
questions.explanation: 原文说“My teacher is Mr. Zhang.”，所以汤姆的老师是张先生。

questions.prompt: What does Ms. Li say at the end?
questions.explanation: 原文中李女士最后说“OK. Have a good day!”，所以选“Have a good day!”。

grammar.title: be 动词否定句与一般疑问句
grammar.explanation: 在英语中，be 动词（am, is, are）的否定句是在 be 动词后面加 not。例如：She is not a student. 一般疑问句是把 be 动词放到主语前面。例如：Are you in Class 2? 回答时用 Yes, I am. 或 No, I am not.
grammar.example: Are you in Class 2? Yes, I am.

questions.prompt: 选择正确的否定句：She ___ a teacher.
questions.explanation: 主语 She 是第三人称单数，be 动词用 is，否定形式是 is not。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的一般疑问句：___ you a student?
questions.explanation: 主语 you 对应的 be 动词是 are，一般疑问句把 are 提前。

questions.prompt: 选择正确的回答：Is he a teacher?
questions.explanation: 主语 he 对应的 be 动词是 is，肯定回答用 Yes, he is.
questions.evidence: Is your teacher Ms. Wang? No, she is not.

questions.prompt: 用 be 动词的否定形式填空：They ___ happy. (缩写形式)
questions.explanation: 主语 they 对应的 be 动词是 are，否定缩写是 aren't。
